preconditions.description: The first line is a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5), and the second line contains exactly n space-separated integers (0 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9).
Input consists of exactly two lines: the first line for n, the second line for the stewards' strengths.
The number of stewards n matches the count of integers in the second line.

postconditions.description: The output is a single non-negative integer representing the count of stewards Jon will support, where 0 ≤ count ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for a in map(int, stdin.splitlines()[1].strip().split()) if any(x < a for x in map(int, stdin.splitlines()[1].strip().split())) and any(x > a for x in map(int, stdin.splitlines()[1].strip().split())))
postconditions.description: The output equals the number of stewards with strength a_i such that there exists at least one steward with strength strictly less than a_i and at least one steward with strength strictly greater than a_i.
